I will try to summarize here the problem, as I know Lucia's work. The =

model-based method instead of the design-based method. The process is, =

probability of detection for each observation, (3) to apply the
Horvitz-Thompson estimator to estimate the number of groups in each =
segment
of the transect line (each sampling unit), (4) to run GLMs or GAMs

response variable.

Encountered a

the
identification number of the model), and it doesn't runt he MRDS. I was
exploring a bit but I couldn't find the reason for this error.=20

But I don't know if there is an easy way to extract the probabilities of
detection from the MCDS engine, as it is with MRDS and R. Before having =
MRDS
I used to extract it from the detection function equation, knowing the
values for each covariate, but it was a rather time-consuming work, so I
wonder if there is an easier way to extract that information from =

problem

average p

from
